findings.location: checkpoint-058-accounting-authority-proposal.md unit catalogue/P02; matrix units B/T and E00/G1-G4
findings.finding: The exhaustive unit bodies do not expressly cover native string value equality in keyword-default comparisons, membership/absence claims in native dictionaries, or the per-key deduplication work in dict.fromkeys(functions). B is restricted to a named lookup followed by pinned-object identity; T omits bounded native value equality; C/W alone do not price deduplication lookup/decision work. The proposed exact-string-only lookup premise also needs to distinguish deduplication storage keyed by exact function objects.
findings.required_correction: Give these operations explicit bounded semantic bodies and occurrence/ownership rules, including a coherent proposed key domain. No whole-collection deduplication may be hidden in one C/W occurrence. A future initialization implementation remains required.
